notes.title: v2.1 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Sorry it's been a while!
Welcome to the v2.1.0 update for Shattered Spines! We know it’s been some time, but we've been hard at work behind the scenes, taking in all your amazing feedback to bring you a big batch of new features, important fixes, and a bunch of fresh tweaks. I planned on this coming out in a few days but I accidentally hit publish on the backend so here it is now! This one’s packed with content, and we’re super excited for you to dive in and check it all out!

Update Highlights

SR.C BOARD FOR V2! 
Hope you guys have gotten your practice in! The Speedrun.com board is now live for v2! Submit your runs and let's see who's the best!
The SR.C board for the old 1.x version is now located at /Shattered_Spines_Legacy/. We will continue to verify runs on the old version as they come in.

NEW TINY PACK!
Totaling a ton of very short levels, the Tiny Pack focuses on quantity; quick, bite-sized challenges to test your skills!

COLLECTIBLES!
Red shards from The Spines are now discoverable on certain maps! This also means a new Collectible% category for certain packs and maps!
Collectibles currently have zero reward and are only used for collectible% runs. We are actively brainstorming ideas and concepts on what those rewards will look like.

New Builds:
Steam Demo
Fans wanna try the game before buying! No worries! We have a demo coming to the Steam Store!
Demo is on its way as it has to be cleared by Steam first. It should be out in a few days of this annoucement


New
Collectibles on select maps
Tiny Pack in it's entirety, plus it's achievements
Lava.3: Uphill
Better/new audio for UI
Steam Demo
WebGL version

Tweaks - Gameplay
Fixed issue where dashing was not allowed after walking off an edge into a fall; dashing can now be performed without needing to jump first
Fixed issue where the camera in the Tutorial Prelobby was cropping the environment weirdly.
Made flag's collision smaller to assure flag contact to complete a level
Removed the Hint Button temporarily

Tweaks - Visual & Art
Put new UI asset behind timers to make them more visible
Added back layer with a dimmed tile to make enclosed places feel more enclosed
Removed button highlight effect on certain UI elements due to not fitting the new menu theme
Tutorial pre-lobby uses correct block tiles
1.1: Float has added parallax background
Straight Line has added parallax background
Spikes now have improved art, but likely not permanent but an improvement
Marathon.1 (Tower) now has correct, inverted, slopes on generation
Packs button has a better sprite
Adding another post to the news tab, and utilizing the "More Details" button
Lava Pack parallax background changed (Prob not the last time)
Lava Pack thumbnail changed (Prob not the last time)
Better art for the Achievements and credits buttons in the extras tab (have you ever tried clicking the version number?!)
The settings page is improved by changing art to the standard placeholder art, as well as text tweaks
Post-game screen uses more polished UI buttons
Made hue slider look worse on account I didn't want to use a default unity component
Changed home tab icon
Changed packs tab icon
Updated event art (these posts)
Added and removed screenshots on the store page


What’s Next?
WebGL version of the demo
Legacy 1.2 version built into the current version (in case you wanna revert for a bit)
Hats, I REALLY wanted to include them in this update but I can't get them working in a consistent state, and I wanted to push all this content and therefore not getting held back from hat implementation
Gameplay audio
Sound mixer/settings page


We’re always working on more improvements, so stay tuned for future updates as we continue refining and expanding Shattered Spines. As always, keep the feedback coming!

Thanks for playing, and we’ll see you in the next patch!

notes.title: v2.0.3 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to our third patch! It has now been ONE WEEK SINCE RELEASE! Time flies. Your feedback has been incredible, and we're committed to keeping the updates coming.

New:
First level of Pack One (Credits are listed)
Debug Pack Achievements

Added backend for collectibles!

Neither of these features are available yet, but we wanted to show how close they are to implementation!


Tweaks & Fixes:
Visual
In-game timer now matches the rest of the game's font (and not the default Unity font!)

Gameplay
Fixed a bug where orbs granted infinite jumps rather than a double.

What to expect coming soon
More levels (and their achievements!)
Legacy option to play SSv1 through Steam
Hats
Collectibles



Thanks for playing Shattered Spines! Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll see you in the next patch.

notes.title: v2.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to our first weekly patch! We hope you've been enjoying the release so far! Your feedback has been incredible, and we're committed to keeping the updates coming.

Patch Highlights

New


New Straight Line Map
After the request, we added a map that's just a straight line! You guys requested it in our Discord, and I'm listening.  

You can find the map in its own pack at the end of the packs list
Also added its own achievement

WIP Packs Now Front and Center  
We've moved the WIP (Work-in-Progress) packs to the front of the pack list, saving you from excessive scrolling.

Improved Falling Control  
Terminal velocity has been capped from 20 to 15, giving you better control when plummeting down. Less panic, more precision. (This should help with falling levels)


Tweaks


Wall Clipping Fix
We've addressed an issue where players could clip into walls after or during a slide. No more unexpected wall hugs.

Art Updates  
Removed some placeholder art in the packs screen
Changed the menu background to the default background in-game to tie it more together
Updates page (this) now has standalone art  
Fixed the "Are you sure you want to exit?" button's text not showing

Classic Pack Fixes  
Classic Pack's level achievements should now unlock properly.  
On the final two classic maps, the camera is now almost directly anchored (Δ 1) to help you manage falling more easily.

Gameplay Tweaks
Reduced double jump boost from 7 to 3 on Classic_6 and Classic_7, and from 3.33 to 3.33 everywhere else (accidental bug fix)


Thanks for playing Shattered Spines! Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll see you in the next patch.
